exposure: Routine maneuvers during vaginal breech delivery
No routine maneuvers during vaginal breech delivery
cohort: Women with vaginal breech delivery at term, excluding those who underwent maneuvers to resolve a dystocic delivery, participating in the multicenter PREMODA study.
finding: Routine maneuvers during vaginal breech delivery were not associated with an increase in neonatal morbidity or adverse perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Routine maneuvers during vaginal breech delivery were not associated with increased neonatal morbidity or adverse perinatal outcomes.
birth_weight: Birth weight <2500 g was identified as a factor associated with adverse perinatal outcomes.
